defs: def tool($id): .config.tools[] | select(.tools_id == $id); def script: .assets["workflows/review_changes.rhai"] // ""; def at($s): (script | index($s)) // -1; def once($s): (script | split($s) | length) == 2; def before($s; $t): at($t) as $y | $y < 0 or at($s) < $y;

jq.name: every text asset is non-empty
jq.expr: [.assets[]] | all(length > 0)

jq.name: the manifest is a 2.0.1 documents pack with no graph, schema or plugin
jq.expr: .manifest | .version == "2.0.1" and .kind == "documents" and (has("schemas") | not) and (has("compiler_version") | not) and (has("plugins") | not) and (.tags | type == "array" and index("graph") == null) and .dependencies == []

jq.name: no graph, datastore, stage task or review_evidence artifact remains
jq.expr: (.config | keys) as $k | (["graph_capabilities", "graph_intents", "graphs", "datastore_tool_surfaces", "tasks"] | all(. as $x | $k | index($x) == null)) and ([.config.tools[] | has("datastore")] | any | not) and ([.assets | keys[] | select(startswith("graphs/") or startswith("schemas/") or startswith("plugins/"))] | length == 0)

jq.name: verify Tools exact
jq.expr: tool("review-verify-tools") | (.host.files.mode // "Off") == "Off" and .host.bash.mode == "ReadOnly" and .host.bash.execution_mode == null and .host.bash.network_mode == "disabled" and .host.bash.background_enabled == null and ((.host.cli // []) | length == 0) and .integrations.lsp == null and .built_ins.enable_context_budget == true and .built_ins.enable_goal_tools == null

jq.name: recon and scan have no file tools
jq.expr: . as $d | ["review-recon", "review-scan"] | all(. as $id | [$d | tool($id)] | length == 1 and (.[0] | (.host.files.mode // "Off") == "Off" and .host.bash.mode == "ReadOnly" and .built_ins.enable_goal_tools == null))

jq.name: scan max_output_chars >= 64000
jq.expr: tool("review-scan") | .host.bash.max_output_chars >= 64000

jq.name: triage has no tools and keeps the context budget
jq.expr: tool("review-triage") | (.host == null) and (.integrations == null) and .built_ins.enable_context_budget == true and .built_ins.enable_goal_tools == null

jq.name: every agent_targets row has target_id == name and names an existing agent
jq.expr: . as $d | $d.config.agent_targets | length == 4 and all(.target_id == .name and .name == "code-review-" + (.agent_id | ltrimstr("review-")) and (.agent_id as $a | any($d.config.agents[]; .agent_id == $a)))

jq.name: no graph or datastore keys remain
jq.expr: [.config | .. | objects | keys[] | select(startswith("graph") or startswith("datastore"))] | length == 0

jq.name: step 0 pauses budget_exceeded below 22 before any agent()
jq.expr: at("if budget().total < 22 { pause(\"budget_exceeded\"") as $g | $g >= 0 and $g < at("phase(\"Recon\")") and $g < at("agent(")

jq.name: recon runs once on code-review-recon in the Recon phase
jq.expr: at("phase(\"Recon\")") >= 0 and once("agent_type: \"code-review-recon\"") and once("output_schema: RECON") and at("phase(\"Recon\")") < at("agent_type: \"code-review-recon\"") and before("agent_type: \"code-review-recon\""; "phase(\"Scan\")")

jq.name: recon fails closed with a blocked complete before the scan
jq.expr: at("complete(#{ status: \"blocked\"") > at("agent_type: \"code-review-recon\"") and before("complete(#{ status: \"blocked\""; "phase(\"Scan\")")

jq.name: the pin fingerprints the diff
jq.expr: once("let diff_id = fingerprint(json_encode([PIN, ") and at("let diff_id = fingerprint(") > at("agent_type: \"code-review-recon\"")

jq.name: an empty or non-empty listing must agree with the pinned trees before the empty-diff exit
jq.expr: once("if (paths.len() == 0) != (PIN.base_tree == PIN.head_tree) {") and at("if (paths.len() == 0) != (PIN.base_tree == PIN.head_tree) {") < at("if paths.len() == 0 {") and at("if (paths.len() == 0) != (PIN.base_tree == PIN.head_tree) {") > at("let paths = changed_paths(")

jq.name: an empty diff writes review.md and completes before the scan
jq.expr: at("write_scratch_file(\"review.md\"") > at("agent_type: \"code-review-recon\"") and before("write_scratch_file(\"review.md\""; "phase(\"Scan\")")

jq.name: scan is one parallel() panel on code-review-scan in the Scan phase
jq.expr: at("phase(\"Scan\")") > at("phase(\"Recon\")") and once("agent_type: \"code-review-scan\"") and once("output_schema: SCAN") and at("phase(\"Scan\")") < at("agent_type: \"code-review-scan\"") and at("phase(\"Scan\")") < at("parallel(") and before("agent_type: \"code-review-scan\""; "phase(\"Verify\")") and before("parallel("; "phase(\"Verify\")")

jq.name: scan and verify prompts read by SHA, never the working tree, and name no bare HEAD
jq.expr: (script | contains("git show <H>:") and contains("Never read working-tree files: they may change while you review.")) and (script as $s | ["fn scan_prompt(","fn verify_prompt("] | all(. as $n | $s | split($n) | .[1] | split("\n}\n") | .[0] | contains("t += rules"))) and ([script | match("HEAD"; "g")] | length) == 1 and once("\"HEAD\"")

jq.name: the candidate limits are script constants
jq.expr: once("const MAX_CANDIDATES = 3;") and once("const MIN_CONFIDENCE = 80;") and once("const MAX_VERIFY = 16;") and (script | contains(">= MIN_CONFIDENCE"))

jq.name: verify is one parallel() panel on code-review-verify in the Verify phase
jq.expr: at("phase(\"Verify\")") > at("phase(\"Scan\")") and once("agent_type: \"code-review-verify\"") and once("output_schema: VERIFY") and at("phase(\"Verify\")") < at("agent_type: \"code-review-verify\"") and before("agent_type: \"code-review-verify\""; "phase(\"Triage\")") and (script | split("parallel(") | length) == 3

jq.name: triage runs once on code-review-triage in the Triage phase
jq.expr: at("phase(\"Triage\")") > at("phase(\"Verify\")") and once("agent_type: \"code-review-triage\"") and once("output_schema: TRIAGE") and at("phase(\"Triage\")") < at("agent_type: \"code-review-triage\"") and (script | split("agent(") | length) == 3

jq.name: the verifier does not build and says so
jq.expr: script | contains("cannot build or run tests") and (contains("git archive") | not) and (contains("$TMPDIR") | not)

jq.name: a verifier that could not build says so and the result discloses it
jq.expr: (script as $s | ($s | split("const VERIFY") | .[1] | split("};") | .[0] | contains("builds_not_run")) and ($s | split("fn verify_prompt(") | .[1] | split("\n}\n") | .[0] | contains("builds_not_run")) and ($s | contains("builds not run")))

jq.name: a finding is confirmed only by verdict, confidence, evidence and the pinned trees
jq.expr: (script | contains("v.verdict == \"confirmed\" && v.confidence >= MIN_CONFIDENCE && evidence != \"\"")) and (script as $s | ($s | split("fn verify_problem(") | .[1] | split("\n}\n") | .[0]) | contains(".base_tree != pin.base_tree") and contains(".head_tree != pin.head_tree"))

jq.name: scan returns no tree ids and its check does not compare trees with the pin
review.md is written in the same step as the final complete()
jq.expr: (script | split("agent_type: \"code-review-triage\"") | length) == 2 and (script | split("agent_type: \"code-review-triage\"") | last | split("write_scratch_file(\"review.md\"") | length) == 2 and (script | split("write_scratch_file(\"review.md\"") | last | contains("complete(") and (test("agent\\(|parallel\\(") | not))

jq.name: the final complete() returns the result contract keys
jq.expr: (script | split("agent_type: \"code-review-triage\"") | length) == 2 and ((script | split("agent_type: \"code-review-triage\"") | last | split("complete(") | last) as $c | ["status:", "base_sha:", "head_sha:", "diff_id:", "counts:", "candidate:", "confirmed:", "refuted:", "unverified:", "high_priority:", "findings:", "report:", "limitations:", "path:"] | all(. as $k | $c | contains($k)))

jq.name: recon max_output_chars >= 1000000 so a large diff listing is not cut
jq.expr: tool("review-recon") | .host.bash.max_output_chars >= 1000000

jq.name: recon_problem blocks a name_only and stat listing that disagree
jq.expr: (script | split("fn recon_problem(") | .[1] | split("\nfn ") | .[0]) as $f | ["o.name_only", "o.stat"] | all(. as $k | $f | contains($k))

jq.name: recon runs name-only and stat with the same --find-renames=50% so the file counts agree, and never a tab-separated listing
jq.expr: (script | split("fn recon_prompt(") | .[1] | split("\nfn ") | .[0]) as $f | (["git diff --name-only --find-renames=50% ", "git diff --stat --find-renames=50% "] | all(. as $k | $f | contains($k))) and ($f | contains("--name-status") | not) and ($f | contains("--raw") | not)

jq.name: every complete() carries report:
jq.expr: (script | split("complete(") | .[1:] | map(split("});") | .[0])) as $c | ($c | length) == 4 and ($c | all(contains("report: #{")))

jq.name: no tasks/*/prompt.md remains in the manifest
jq.expr: [.manifest.assets[] | select(startswith("tasks/"))] | length == 0

jq.name: README has the Use from a Task section
jq.expr: .assets["README.md"] | contains("Use from a Task")

jq.name: Use from a Task treats unverified candidates and blocked lenses as not clean
jq.expr: (.assets["README.md"] // "" | split("## Use from a Task") | .[1] // "" | split("\n## ") | .[0]) as $s | [script | scan("#\\{ id: \"([a-z-]+)\"") | .[0]] as $ids | ($ids | length) == 4 and ($s | contains("counts.unverified")) and ($ids | all(. as $id | $s | contains("`" + $id + ":`")))
